spec.title: Setup: build Spring Security core at the three #14196 revisions and run the role hierarchy tests
spec.description: Setup for Brief A2 (llm-dlc/loops/spring-and-java-data-workstream-briefs.md), no claims. In the worktrees under ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data/src (made by the setup session; the Gradle 8.5 distribution and JDK 17 are already there), builds spring-security-core at 10d88cdf (before), 7d366242 (feature commit, adds RoleHierarchyImpl.Builder) and ee8bc78c (landed polish) with each checkout's own wrapper and dependencies, and runs each side's own RoleHierarchyImplTests and AuthorityAuthorizationManagerTests. The first run downloads the build's dependencies into ~/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data/gradle-home; the landed tests are then rerun with --offline to show the cache is complete. Each jar is copied to .../artifacts/spring-security-14196-REV.jar with its sha256, the runtime classpath is written to .../logs, and the build trees are removed at the end (git clean in each worktree). Results go into llm-dlc/loops/spring-and-java-data-setup.md.
spec.expected: every step exits 0: each revision's tests run (junit tests=N>0, failures=0) and its jar digest is printed; the offline rerun ends BUILD SUCCESSFUL

resources.notes: Gradle daemon -Xmx3g from gradle.properties plus test JVMs; first run downloads dependencies, later revisions hit the build cache

steps.name: spring-security-14196-before: build core, run RoleHierarchyImplTests and AuthorityAuthorizationManagerTests
spring-security-14196-feature: build core, run RoleHierarchyImplTests and AuthorityAuthorizationManagerTests
spring-security-14196-landed: build core, run RoleHierarchyImplTests and AuthorityAuthorizationManagerTests
spring-security-14196-landed: the same tests offline
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; B=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data; export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$B/gradle-home TMPDIR=$B/tmp; mkdir -p $B/tmp $B/logs $B/artifacts; export JAVA_HOME=$HOME/.sdkman/candidates/java/17.0.21.0+9-tem; G="./gradlew --no-daemon --console=plain -Porg.gradle.java.installations.auto-download=false "; cd $B/src/spring-security-14196-landed; $G --offline :spring-security-core:test --tests 'org.springframework.security.access.hierarchicalroles.RoleHierarchyImplTests' --tests 'org.springframework.security.authorization.AuthorityAuthorizationManagerTests' --rerun 2>&1 | tee $B/logs/spring-security-14196-landed.spring-security-core.offline-test.log | tail -5; grep -q 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' $B/logs/spring-security-14196-landed.spring-security-core.offline-test.log

steps.name: remove the build trees
steps.run: set -euo pipefail; B=$HOME/.cache/in-the-loop/spring-java-data; export GRADLE_USER_HOME=$B/gradle-home TMPDIR=$B/tmp; mkdir -p $B/tmp $B/logs $B/artifacts; git -C $B/src/spring-security-14196-before clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-security-14196-before status --short | wc -l; git -C $B/src/spring-security-14196-feature clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-security-14196-feature status --short | wc -l; git -C $B/src/spring-security-14196-landed clean -fdxq; git -C $B/src/spring-security-14196-landed status --short | wc -l; du -sh $B/src
